primary_task: Implement an OAuth/OIDC or session authentication flow with validation middleware and negative tests in the repository.

requirements.name: Read/Write/Edit/Bash
requirements.evidence: 'Implement flows that validate every assertion and fail closed by default'
requirements.basis: bash: run shell commands on Linux x86_64: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads), build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh, start and stop local servers inside the session

requirements.name: identity provider account (Auth0, Clerk, Cognito, Keycloak, Supabase)
requirements.evidence: 'Vendor-neutral evaluation of Auth0, Clerk, Cognito, Keycloak, and Supabase'
requirements.basis: lacks: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)

requirements.name: answers from the invoking agent/user on IdPs and tenancy
requirements.evidence: 'Ask the invoking agent for the identity providers, tenancy model, and client types in use'
requirements.basis: ask_user: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation

notes: No live IdP is a must; flows are built and tested locally (local servers allowed). A real SSO/IdP integration test would be BLOCKED.
